text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation here. The first image offers a glimpse through glass walls into a modern, almost clinical conference or classroom setting—it feels open and transparent, yet slightly isolating, an environment both inviting and detached. The second image bursts with color and information, an exhibit space devoted to research and development, sparking thoughts about innovation and the future. The displays and text encourage me to contemplate the relationship between humans and technology. Surrounded by knowledge in motion, I feel at once small, yet swept up in the momentum of progress.
